description.source_text: Pengenalan Training Training RCNA WLAN + Exam merupakan program pelatihan yang dirancang untuk membekali peserta dengan pengetahuan dan keterampilan dasar mengenai implementasi, konfigurasi, dan troubleshooting jaringan wireless menggunakan teknologi Ruijie/Reyee. Pelatihan ini mengacu pada sertifikasi RCNA (Ruijie Certified Network Associate) WLAN yang berfokus pada pengelolaan jaringan Wi-Fi di lingkungan enterprise maupun bisnis. Peserta akan mempelajari konsep dasar wireless LAN, arsitektur jaringan WLAN, konfigurasi access point, manajemen controller, keamanan jaringan wireless, roaming, optimasi performa Wi-Fi, hingga troubleshooting jaringan wireless. Pelatihan dilengkapi dengan praktik langsung (hands-on lab) agar peserta mampu memahami implementasi WLAN secara nyata di dunia kerja. Pada akhir pelatihan, peserta akan mengikuti ujian sertifikasi RCNA WLAN sebagai validasi kompetensi dalam bidang jaringan wireless berbasis Ruijie/Reyee.

duration.source_text: Durasi Training 4 Hari (Jam Belajar Mulai Pukul 09.00 s.d 17.00 WIB Perharinya)

curriculum.source_text: CURRICULUM Module 1 — WLAN Introduction • Basic Access, PSK Authentication Configuration for Fat APs • WLAN Introduction • Advantages and Disadvantages of WLAN • Wireless Network Classification • WLAN Technology Development Trend Module 2 — L2 Networking & RF Fundamentals • RF Basics • WLAN Transmission Channels • 802.11 Protocol • WLAN Basics Module 3 — L3 Networking & WLAN Architecture • WLAN System Composition • Wireless Devices • Wireless AES • WLAN Architecture Module 4 — WLAN Networking & Roaming • WLAN Networking • Bridging and Roaming Module 5 — Data Forwarding & CAPWAP • Data Forwarding Modes • CAPWAP Protocol Principles Module 6 — Fat AP & Fit AP Networking • Fat AP-based Networking and Configuration • Fit AP-based Networking and Configuration Module 7 — Roaming Concepts • Basic Concepts of Roaming • Intra-AC Roaming Module 8 — Wireless Hot Backup & Virtual AC • Principles of Wireless Hot Backup • Wireless AC Hot Backup • Virtual AC Module 9 — WLAN Security • Introduction to WLAN Security Background • WLAN Security Technologies • WLAN Network Access Control • WLAN Security Configuration • User Isolation • Blacklist and Whitelist Module 10 — WLAN Optimization • WLAN Optimization Background • WLAN Optimization Guide Module 11 — Site Survey • Site Survey Preparations • Wireless Signal Propagation Interference Mitigation Methods • Site Survey Knowledge and Methods • Common Site Survey Tools
